summary: Select Medical Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing shareholder litigation challenging its pending going-private acquisition. The Merger Agreement, dated March 2, 2026, provides for acquisition by an entity affiliated with a consortium led by Executive Chairman Robert Ortenzio, Senior EVP Martin Jackson, and Welsh Carson Anderson & Stowe, resulting in Merger Sub merging with and into Select Medical. The filing does not state price per share, premium, or expected close. Three complaints filed in New York and Pennsylvania allege the definitive proxy statement (filed May 19, 2026) omits material information. The board has not yet recommended. Watch for supplemental disclosures or settlement to clear the way for stockholder vote at the June 26, 2026 special meeting.
